title: 19.13. Uppannattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Naanuppanno dhammo uppannassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Nauppādī dhammo uppannassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Naanuppanno ca nauppādī ca dhammā uppannassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe adhipatiyā satta, sahajāte aññamaññe nissaye tīṇi, upanissaye satta, purejāte pacchājāte tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
